span: an application for maintenance can be maintained only by a “wife” who is a legally wedded wife
why: Respondent's argument about whether the claimant is a legally wedded wife, not a divorced wife; it is a party submission.

span: The scope and ambit of power and jurisdiction of this Court under Article 142(1) of the Constitution of India

span: “wife” includes a woman who has been divorced by, or has obtained a divorce from, her husband and has not remarried
why: Quoted statutory Explanation (b) that includes a divorced wife; statute text quoted by the court, not the court's own holding in this passage.

span: the proceedings were dropped and a divorce was obtained

span: appellant No.1 being a wife and appellants No.2 and 3 being their children are entitled to claim maintenance under Section 125 Cr.P.C.

why: Headnote of the concurring opinion holding that a divorced Muslim woman can seek maintenance under s.125; headnote confidence is capped.
